description: Newsletter and Communication Impact Dashboard - Track message reach, response rates, and communication effectiveness

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM decidim_newsletters WHERE sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as value 
FROM decidim_users u 
INNER JOIN decidim_newsletters n ON TRUE
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL 
  AND u.type = 'Decidim::User' 
  AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND u.newsletter_notifications_at IS NOT NULL
  AND n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days';

WITH newsletter_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN u.id END) as active_after,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as total_recipients
  FROM decidim_newsletters n
  CROSS JOIN decidim_users u
  WHERE n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL 
    AND u.type = 'Decidim::User' 
    AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND u.newsletter_notifications_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN total_recipients > 0 THEN ROUND((active_after * 100.0 / total_recipients), 2)
    ELSE 0
  END as value
FROM newsletter_activity;

SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id
  FROM decidim_users u
  INNER JOIN decidim_newsletters n ON TRUE
  WHERE u.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at 
    AND u.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '24 hours'
    AND n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL 
    AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
) immediate_response;

WITH communication_impact AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', n.sent_at) as time,
    'Newsletters Sent' as metric,
    COUNT(*) as value
  FROM decidim_newsletters n
  WHERE n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', n.sent_at)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', u.last_sign_in_at) as time,
    'User Logins' as metric,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as value
  FROM decidim_users u
  WHERE u.last_sign_in_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL 
    AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', u.last_sign_in_at)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as time,
    'New Activity' as metric,
    COUNT(*) as value
  FROM (
    SELECT created_at FROM decidim_proposals_proposals WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT created_at FROM decidim_comments_comments WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
  ) activities
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
)
SELECT time, metric, SUM(value) as value
FROM communication_impact
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time;

WITH weekly_response AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('week', n.sent_at) as time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '1 day' THEN u.id END) as "Day 1 Response",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '3 days' THEN u.id END) as "Day 3 Response",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN u.id END) as "Day 7 Response"
  FROM decidim_newsletters n
  CROSS JOIN decidim_users u
  WHERE n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL 
    AND u.type = 'Decidim::User' 
    AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND u.newsletter_notifications_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', n.sent_at)
)
SELECT 
  time,
  'Day 1 Response' as metric,
  "Day 1 Response" as value
FROM weekly_response
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  time,
  'Day 3 Response' as metric,
  "Day 3 Response" as value
FROM weekly_response
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  time,
  'Day 7 Response' as metric,
  "Day 7 Response" as value
FROM weekly_response
ORDER BY time, metric;

WITH newsletter_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    n.id,
    COALESCE(n.subject->>'en', n.subject->>'it', n.subject->>'fr', n.subject->>'de', n.subject->>'es', n.subject::text) as subject,
    n.sent_at,
    u_author.name as author_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u_recipient.id) as total_recipients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u_recipient.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u_recipient.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN u_recipient.id END) as day1_responses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u_recipient.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u_recipient.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN u_recipient.id END) as week1_responses,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u_recipient.last_sign_in_at >= n.sent_at AND u_recipient.last_sign_in_at <= n.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN u_recipient.id END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u_recipient.id), 0)), 2
    ) as response_rate
  FROM decidim_newsletters n
  LEFT JOIN decidim_users u_author ON n.author_id = u_author.id
  CROSS JOIN decidim_users u_recipient
  WHERE n.sent_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$time_range days'
    AND n.sent_at IS NOT NULL
    AND u_recipient.deleted_at IS NULL 
    AND u_recipient.type = 'Decidim::User' 
    AND u_recipient.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND u_recipient.newsletter_notifications_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY n.id, n.subject, n.sent_at, u_author.name
)
SELECT 
  subject,
  author_name,
  sent_at,
  total_recipients,
  day1_responses,
  week1_responses,
  response_rate
FROM newsletter_performance
WHERE total_recipients > 0
ORDER BY sent_at DESC;

title: Newsletter & Communication Impact
